## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company issuing guidance." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `BenzingaId` | String | A unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the guidance record. | REST |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company issuing guidance. | REST |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 code representing the currency in which the company issued its guidance figures. | REST |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the guidance was issued. | REST |
| `EpsMethod` | String | The methodology of the EPS figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), ffo (Funds From Operations, a non-GAAP metric commonly used to assess the operating performance of REITs), and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). | REST |
| `EstimatedEpsGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus EPS estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. | REST |
| `EstimatedRevenueGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus revenue estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. | REST |
| `FiscalPeriod` | String | The fiscal quarter to which the guidance applies, such as Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4. | REST |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year corresponding to the period for which the guidance is issued. | REST |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). | REST |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the record was last updated in the system. | REST |
| `MaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST |
| `MaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST |
| `MinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST |
| `MinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST |
| `Notes` | String | Additional descriptive text or commentary provided about the guidance record. | REST |
| `Positioning` | String | Indicates how a particular guidance value is presented relative to other figures disclosed by the company. Possible values are 'primary' (the emphasized figure) and 'secondary' (a supporting or alternate figure) | REST |
| `PreviousMaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST |
| `PreviousMaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST |
| `PreviousMinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST |
| `PreviousMinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST |
| `ReleaseType` | String | Indicates whether the guidance was issued as part of a scheduled earnings release ('official') or as an unscheduled update ('preliminary'). | REST |
| `RevenueMethod` | String | The methodology of the revenue figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). | REST |
| `Time` | String | The time of day the guidance was announced, in HH:mm:ss format. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (in code or in the settings file, as `unreadable_symbols: raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
